IIFA 2026 अवॉर्ड्स में फिल्म Dhurandhar ने मचा दिया है पूरा धमाल। 🎬
इस फिल्म ने बेस्ट फिल्म, बेस्ट डायरेक्टर (आदित्य धर) और बेस्ट एक्टर (रणवीर सिंह) समेत कई बड़े अवॉर्ड्स अपने नाम किए। 🏆
डिजिटल कैटेगरी में The Ba***ds of Bollywood बनी बेस्ट वेब सीरीज और आर्यन खान को मिला बेस्ट डायरेक्टर का अवॉर्ड। 💻
इसके अलावा Saiyaara के लिए अनीता पड्ढा को बेस्ट एक्ट्रेस का खिताब मिला है। 🌟
क्या आपको लगता है कि इस साल Dhurandhar ही सबसे हकदार विनर थी? नीचे कॉमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

Aryan Khan was adjudged Best Web Series Director for The Ba***ds of Bollywood.
The 2026 IIFA Awards saw Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar emerge as the biggest winner of the evening, taking home the maximum number of awards. The film won several major honours, including Best Film, Best Director for Aditya Dhar and Best Actor for Ranveer Singh.
Aditya Dhar also received the Best Story, Best Screenplay and Best Dialogues awards for Dhurandhar, making it a particularly successful outing for the filmmaker at the awards ceremony. The film's multiple wins underline its strong showing across the major categories.
Aneet Padda won the Best Actress award for her performance in Saiyaara. The actress thus took home one of the prominent acting honours at the 2026 ceremony.
In the digital awards category, The Ba***ds of Bollywood emerged as the winner of Best Web Series. The series also brought recognition to Aryan Khan, who won Best Director for his work on the show.
With Dhurandhar leading the winners' tally, the 2026 IIFA Awards recognised achievements across theatrical cinema as well as the digital entertainment space. While Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh were among the biggest winners in the film categories, Aneet Padda also secured an important honour for Saiyaara.
